[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling>=1.25"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project]
name = "invoicer"
version = "1.4.0"
description = "Invoice models, pricing, validation and reports for a small billing service"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = [
    "pydantic==2.14.1",
    "pydantic-settings>=2.10",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8",
]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["src/invoicer"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]

answer: Upgraded pydantic to 2.14.1 and migrated 6 source file(s); build and tests pass.
